ns2:section.sectionText: The yield sign icon indicates that there are open seats, but some seats may be restricted to majors or minors. Check your registration screen to see if there is an open seat for you. This online studio course will introduce students’ to painting practices through the exploration of various theories, techniques, and themes. Class subjects will explore value and color, mixing acrylic and gouache paint, and a variety of mark-making techniques. Students will be required to have a remote place to paint, a digital camera for documentation, and a working computer with internet access.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History major(s) or minor(s).
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Not intended for First Time Freshman students.
